Ready when you are
ShareX keeps file sharing simple, fast, and on your local network.
Connect both devices to the same Wi-Fi or use your phone’s hotspot.
Share a folder, a storage root, or just the files you select.
Browse files, preview media, and move files between your devices.
ShareX asks for access when a feature needs it.
Choose your folder, start sharing, and open the page on another device.
No cloud uploads. Files move directly between your phone and a nearby browser.\n\nNo account needed. Works on Windows, Mac, Linux, and other phones.
Tap Start in ShareX to open a sharing session.\n\nScan the QR code or type the sharing address into the other device’s browser.
Use Shared folder in Settings to choose a folder or a storage root.\n\nPrivate mode limits the browser to files you explicitly share.
Preview images, audio, video, and supported documents before downloading.\n\nChoose a browser theme in the app. Switch light or dark mode on the web.
Allow file access so ShareX can browse your chosen folders.\n\nApprove new browsers on your phone. Remember only devices you trust.
Keep both devices on the same local network while sharing.\n\nTap Stop when you finish to end the current sharing session.
